verdict.rationale: The marketing site lists 'Pagamentos em lote' (batch payments) as a product feature, which is a first-party bulk operation, but only for payments. The documented API endpoints (cards, VCNs, categories, users) all operate on single items or return paginated lists, with no bulk mutation endpoints. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond payments (cards, transactions, categories, users), API or agent-accessible batch endpoints, documentation of how batch payments work and their limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
